title: Write and run JAL in your browser
introduction: Jaspera is an editor and runtime for JAL, a JVM assembly language. Edit the examples to explore instructions and the operand stack.
imageAlt: Jaspera with the editor and project tree side by side.

sections.title: From editing to execution
sections.body: Instruction, type and method completion, diagnostics and formatting are available. Programs run on a JVM inside the browser.

sections.title: Follow the values
sections.body: Pause at breakpoints and step through stack and local-variable changes. The instruction reference includes examples; the graph shows data dependencies and control flow.
sections.imageAlt: Paused at a breakpoint with the stack and local variables visible.

sections.title: Open your files
sections.body: Open and edit JAL, class and JAR files. Rearrange panels or detach them into separate windows. The interface supports seven languages.
